name: 6.3 Using the Central Limit Theorem
_note: Built 2026-08-12. Three reuses (q5-clt-single-vs-sample, q4-x-bar-probability, q2-x-bar-conditions - all health=ok, never filed, cross-assignment reuse is fine) plus seven authored (q22-mean-sum-or-individual, q23-law-of-large-numbers, q24-normal-approx-conditions, q25-binomial-at-least, q26-binomial-at-most, q27-binomial-between-and-exact, pre-frq-grade-a-continuity-correction) = ten. Points 10+10+10+10+10+10+9+9+10+12 = 100. BookSHelf 6.3 is using the CLT: the mean-vs-sum-vs-individual decision, the law of large numbers, and the normal approximation to the binomial with the continuity correction (P(X>=a) becomes P(Y>=a-0.5), etc. - all corrected boundaries precomputed, never binompdf/binomcdf). Pre-FRQ is authored-first (no continuity-correction FRQ to mirror; the CLT-reasoning and sum-interpretation mirrors are claimed by 6.1/6.2): categories State the Binomial Setup (3) / Apply the Continuity Correction (5) / Compute and Interpret (4), dropped category APPLY THE CONTINUITY CORRECTION.
